name: OneHotEncodeNode
label: One-Hot Encode
description: Creates one new binary (0/1) column for each distinct value in the source column. Optionally drops the original column. Produces one row per distinct value unless a single row is selected for the whole table.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the categorical column to encode.

fields.name: ColumnToEncode
fields.label: Column To Encode
fields.description: The categorical column to one-hot encode.

fields.name: ColumnPrefix
fields.label: Column Prefix
fields.description: Optional prefix for the generated columns. Defaults to the source column name.

fields.name: DropSourceColumn
fields.label: Drop Source Column
fields.description: True to remove the original column from the result. Defaults to false.

fields.name: EncodedDataTable
fields.label: Encoded Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with the one-hot encoded columns.
